standard_prerequisites: Context span 3734-3743: X = Spec(A) with A = k[x, y, z_1, z_2, ...]/(x^n z_n), the ring from Properties, Example does-not-work-in-general; I = (x); U = D(x) quasi-compact open; as seen in the referenced Properties example there is a section s of O_X(U) which does not come from an A-module map I^n -> A for any n >= 0

Context span 3745-3766: alpha: A -> J an embedding into an injective A-module, Q = J/alpha(A) with quotient beta; the claim is that Gamma(X, J~) -> Gamma(U, J~) is not surjective since alpha(s) is not in the image; by contradiction, x in J restricting to alpha(s) over U gives beta(x) in Q restricting to 0 over U, hence I^n beta(x) = 0 for some n (Properties, sections-over-quasi-compact-open-in-affine); this yields phi: I^n -> A, h -> alpha^{-1}(h x), which by the same Properties lemma gives rise to the section s - contradicting the choice of s
core_obligations: J is an injective A-module (context: embedding of A into an injective)
The restriction map Gamma(X, J~) -> Gamma(U, J~) for the standard open U = D(x) is not surjective: alpha(s) is a section over U not in the image (context complete contradiction)
Hence the sheaf J~ associated to an injective module need not be flasque
